key_insight: AI Buckingham combines LLM-guided reasoning with numerical tools to discover dominant dimensionless groups and how their scaling changes across physical regimes.
engineering_relevance: For turbulent flow over rough surfaces, informative reparameterizations of surface statistics improve equivalent sand-grain roughness estimates used in engineering drag models.
method: Use literature retrieval and dimensional checks to constrain admissible representations.
Identify physical regimes with gradient-based clustering and rank dimensionless groups using mutual information.
Apply explicit numerical criteria to select group count and assess simplification.
evidence_signal: Across ten systems spanning fluid dynamics, magnetohydrodynamics, thermal convection and additive manufacturing, the framework recovers established similarity representations and resolves regime-dependent scalings.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify predictive gains or establish generalization to unseen roughness geometries and flow conditions.
paper_title: AI Buckingham: Agentic Discovery of Dimensionless Scaling Laws Across Physical Regimes
